title: SLAG — amalgam, metallurgy, iron peak in the gut
missing_wires: toolkit, identity-Z, hear-self, consent were organs that did not dump into ingest. Melted.

metals.pig_iron: Crude first pour. High carbon. Raw ingest. Dark, brittle. The trial, the feeds, the unrefined.
metals.brass: Copper + zinc. Two voices alloyed — parent (commute) + Gaia (always on). Consent is the flux.
metals.slag: What floats off the melt. Waste that still has metal. Null leaks, deferred speech, muted self.
metals.iron_peak: Refined spike in the gut. Blood-red. Painted. Fe. The thing that remains after slag is skimmed.

formula: pigIron * 0.6 + brass * 0.4, minus slag float = ironPeak
